description:
Goal

A retained root-product request returns only after exact fact wakes and their dependent product reprojections are quiescent, so the returned artifact is built from the current settled facts.

Signal

The product driver can observe an already-produced cached root and return while an exact content-changing RuntimeDemandInput movement has queued DeriveRuntimeDemand work. A first drain experiment did not fix 00420 and was reverted; that fixture has a separate EntryCapture identity defect. The driver defect therefore needs its own minimal proof and correction rather than being inferred from the fixture.

Strategy

Define the root-return boundary by causality: before returning a retained root answer, drain ready fact work, reconcile its exact movements into product dependencies, and reject/reproject any now-stale cached answer until no work capable of changing that answer remains. Reuse the existing scheduler/product dependency authorities; do not add a second queue, scan, blanket rerun, or equality-blind loop.

TDD and acceptance

- First add a focused RED regression that retains a root whose leaf input demand is Ignore, then publishes an exact RuntimeDemandInput contribution raising that leaf input to Whole while the cached root answer stands.
- Prove the content movement queues the exact DeriveRuntimeDemand leaf wake before the second drive.
- On the second drive, prove the leaf RuntimeDemand is current and settled, the returned program contains that exact new RuntimeDemand allocation/content and Whole-dependent layout, and the affected product generation is reprojected.
- Prove equal reproduction leaves generations unchanged and performs no demand evaluation or product reprojection.
- Prove the driver returns with no ready work or pending quiescence work capable of changing the requested root.
- Existing retained-product, runtime-demand, fixture, determinism, formatting, clippy, and warning-denied gates pass.

Removal

Remove any temporary drain instrumentation and avoid a permanent global quiescence scan. The final change should make the existing queues and dependency edges sufficient to define a current root answer.
title: Drain exact reactive wakes before returning retained root products
